description: k102: the missing-source command never names a source the target config already has: the user config's `peter` is a local override and only the project config gives it the bundle's address, so the user scope has no source serving it and the printed command is `skilletor add peter-2 …`, both configs byte-identical; with --project the merged `peter` serves it – no missing source – and the sync installs the bundle's rule from the user's local checkout (author mode, spec §15.6).
